notes: Locate phase. app.js and styles.css are each one minified line; locations give line 1 plus the 1-based column of the matched text, found by exact string search over the file. Findings that share a code cause share an anchor: .slot:focus rule app.js:1:5439 (F-0016, F-0027); inline order:-1 app.js:1:6099 (F-0017, F-0020); few colour app.js:1:1287 light / 890 dark (F-0001, F-0002, F-0036, F-0085); <=360px fixed grid app.js:1:5508 (F-0009, F-0010, F-0029); late aria-live app.js:1:6564 (F-0015, F-0040); 900 ms slot reload in E() app.js:1:6701 (F-0019, F-0032, F-0061, F-0102, F-0103); permit field visible due to .field{display:flex} overriding [hidden] styles.css:1:2389 (F-0045, F-0069); 1200 ms permit reveal app.js:1:8521 (F-0018); permit validated only at Book app.js:1:9805 + 12118 (F-0034, F-0064); hold check G() app.js:1:4078 + hold start 7718 (F-0037, F-0043, F-0079, F-0104); expiry error item without href app.js:1:11852 (F-0025, F-0037, F-0105); When page always starts on Today app.js:1:5208 (F-0047, F-0060); phone-only change route done.html:39 (F-0054, F-0078). New root cause found while locating: the permit field (#permit-wrap) carries the hidden attribute but styles.css .field{display:flex} (col 2389) overrides the UA [hidden] rule, and only .date-row[hidden] and .info__panel[hidden] are restored, so the field shows for Car and before any choice; the 1200 ms reveal timer therefore changes nothing visible. Correction: F-0032's first anchor 6701 is the 900 ms setTimeout inside E(); the emptying statement r.innerHTML="" is at col 6669. No builder notes or other evaluators' outputs were read.
